report:
Cervix, cone biopsy

Received in formalin is a cone biopsy specimen with stitch at 12 o'clock. The specimen measures 10 mm from 12 to 6 o'clock, 15 mm from 3 to 9 o'clock and 15 mm from superficial to deep. No macroscopic lesion is seen. The margins are inked: ectocervix - blue, endocervix - black, radial - green. Radially sectioned and embedded in a clockwise fashion. All embedded in 11 blocks.

(1-10) 1 to 10 o'clock respectively.
(11) 11 and 12 o'clock.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Cone biopsy
- Tumour site: 4 to 9 o'clock

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Adenocarcinoma, HPV-associated, intestinal type
- Histologic grade: G1: Well differentiated
- p16 immunohistochemistry: Positive
- Depth of stromal invasion: Not more than 3 mm (deepest 1.9 mm, 7 o'clock)
- Depth of stromal invasion (proportion): Superficial one-third
- Horizontal extent of stromal invasion: Estimated as greater than 7 mm
  - Number of blocks involved: 6/11 (blocks 4 to 9)
- Silva pattern of invasion: Pattern A
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Tumour histology:
  Sections of the cervix show involvement by HPV-associated adenocarcinoma, intestinal type, from 4 to 9 o'clock. Infiltrating glands are lined by atypical intestinal-type epithelium with goblet cells.

Margins
- Surgical margins: Uninvolved by invasive adenocarcinoma
  - Ectocervical margin: 7 o'clock, 4.5 mm
  - Endocervical / lower uterine segment margin: 9 o'clock, 2.6 mm
  - Radial (circumferential) margin: 7 o'clock, 3.3 mm

Pathological stage (AJCC 9th edition)
- pTNM: pT1a1

Additional findings
- Additional pathologic findings: Inflammation

CERVIX, cone biopsy:
- ADENOCARCINOMA, HPV-associated
- Margins clear
- pT1a1 (AJCC 9th edition).
